text: Package inspection assistant (work from home). We ship packages to your address, you open them, check the items match the invoice and reship them overseas with the prepaid labels we email you. Pay is $2,800 a month plus $40 per package. No experience needed and you can start this week. To apply send your full name, home address and date of birth.

Remote Admin Assistant. Congratulations you have been selected for this position! We will mail you a check for $3,450 to buy your home office equipment from our approved vendor. Deposit the check and pay the vendor by Zelle the same day. Training starts Monday.

DATA ENTRY CLERK $35/HR NO EXPERIENCE!! Work 2-3 hrs a day from your phone, simple typing, flexible schedule and weekly pay. Students welcome. Interview is done by text on Telegram. Limited spots so apply now

Online product reviewer, part time. Earn $300-$800 per day liking and rating products in our app. Finish 40 tasks a session to unlock bonus commission. A small deposit activates your premium task account. All payouts are in USDT.

Personal Assistant to CEO (Remote). Our CEO travels all the time and needs someone to handle errands and purchases. You'll be hired after a short chat interview. Part of the job is buying gift cards for client appreciation and sending photos of the card numbers. $25/hr and we reimburse everything.

Payment processing agent wanted. We are an international trading company and need agents in the US to receive customer payments in their personal bank account and send them on to our company accounts. You keep 10% of every transfer. About 1 hour of work per day.

Mystery shopper needed in your area, get paid to shop! You'll get a cashier's check for $2,000. Spend $200 evaluating a local store, keep $300 as your fee, and send the rest through a money transfer service as part of the evaluation.

Brand Ambassador - teens welcome!! Partner with our wellness drink brand. Your starter kit is $149 and you earn commission on every friend or family member you sign up. Our top ambassadors make six figures. Be your own boss and pick your own hours.

Customer Service Rep, work from home. Start immediately at $28/hr with full benefits from day one. To finish onboarding today please send a photo of your drivers license, your social security number and your bank login so we can set up direct deposit.

Earn $500/week with car wrap advertising. Drive your normal routes with a sponsor logo on your car. We send you a check to pay the wrap installer, you deposit it and send the installer fee by Cash App.

Crypto Payroll Coordinator, remote. You'll help pay our contractors around the world. Bitcoin gets sent to a wallet we set up for you and you convert it into gift cards following our instructions. $4,000 a month, no degree or experience required.

Government summer jobs for students, guaranteed placement. There are thousands of federal jobs most people never hear about. A one-time $89 registration fee gets you priority placement and a guaranteed interview, and the fee is refunded after your first paycheck.

Remote typing job with paid training. Make up to $1,200/week typing captions at home. You need to buy our certification software ($79) before you start. We are only hiring 50 people today, message our recruiter on WhatsApp.

Home based warehouse quality checker. Electronics get shipped to your house, you inspect them and forward them to our distribution partner. $750 weekly. You have to be home for deliveries every day. There's no interview, just reply YES with your address.

Hi! I came across your resume online and you'd be a great fit for a part time remote role with our company. It pays $45/hr with flexible hours. Download our messaging app and contact the hiring manager there to get your offer letter today.
Online chat moderator from home, $40/hr chatting with customers. No experience and no interview. Before we can send your first payment there is a $60 account verification fee, paid with a gift card.

Summer job for high school and college students: package forwarding coordinator. Boxes from our online store come to you, you relabel them and ship them back out. We pay for shipping. $25 a box, paid after 30 days.

Investment assistant, training provided. Learn trading from our senior advisors and get paid while you learn. Put $250 into our trading platform to start the paid training program. Returns are guaranteed at 20% a week.

Virtual assistant needed urgently. The work is simple, mostly buying supplies and sending receipts. We deposit $1,900 in your account first, you buy what we need and send back whatever is left the same day. Reply within 24 hours or we offer the job to the next person.

App tester, get paid daily. $20 for every new app you download and test. Do 15 tests a day to reach VIP level. If you want to withdraw more than $100 you have to top up your account balance first. Join the team group on Telegram.

Barista, Bluebird Coffee, Sacramento CA. Part time, weekends and two weekday afternoons. $17.50/hr plus tips. You don't need experience because we train you on the job and pay you for it. Apply in store or on our website and the store manager will set up an in-person interview.

Camp Counselor - Lakeview YMCA Day Camp. You'll run activities for kids 6 to 11, June through August, Monday to Friday 8am-4pm. Must be at least 16. Everyone does a paid 3-day orientation with CPR training first. $16/hr. All staff go through a background check.

Part-time sales associate at Harbor Outfitters in Portland, OR. Help customers, restock and work the register, 15-25 hours a week with some evenings. Pay is $16.25/hr and you get 30% off. Interviews are in person at the store.

Math tutor wanted at Riverside Learning Center for middle schoolers in pre-algebra and algebra. 6-10 hours a week after school. Juniors and seniors with good math grades are welcome to apply. $18/hr. The interview includes a short teaching demo.

Lifeguard, City of Fresno Parks & Recreation (summer season). You supervise swimmers at the public pools. You need to be 15 or older and have, or get, a Red Cross lifeguard certification, which the city pays you back for. $17/hr. Apply on the city's jobs site.

Courtesy clerk at Valley Fresh Market. Bagging groceries, helping customers out to their cars and bringing in carts. Shifts are flexible for students, about 10-20 hrs a week, $16/hr. You have to be 16. Apply online or ask at the customer service desk.

Library Page, Oak Grove Public Library. Shelving returned books, keeping the collection in order and helping staff with small projects. 8-12 hours a week after school and on Saturdays, $16/hr. Minimum age 15. Applications go through the county jobs website.

Starlight Cinemas is hiring crew. You'd sell tickets, work concessions and clean the theaters between shows, mostly evenings and weekends. $15.75/hr and you see movies free. We hold group interviews at the theater every Tuesday at 4pm.

Sunny Burger in Phoenix is hiring crew members to take orders, cook and keep the place clean. We schedule around school. $15/hr, a free meal every shift, and tuition help once you've been here 6 months. Apply in person or online.

Swim instructor at the Maple Valley Aquatics Center teaching group lessons to kids 4-10. Weekday evenings and Saturday mornings. You need to be 16+ and a strong swimmer, and we'll train you as a Water Safety Instructor. $18/hr.

Paid summer internship with Green Streets, a community nonprofit. You'd help run neighborhood clean-ups and keep track of volunteer sign-ups, 20 hrs/week for 8 weeks at $17/hr. Open to high school students 16 and up. Send a short cover letter and one reference.

Online reading tutor, remote and part time, with BrightPath Tutoring. You work with elementary students over video for 5-10 hours a week. Must be 17+ and have a computer that works reliably. $17/hr, paid every two weeks by direct deposit after a video interview and a background check. It costs nothing to apply or join.

Smile Dental Group needs a part-time front desk receptionist on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons and Saturdays. Greeting patients, answering the phone and booking appointments. $17/hr. Customer service experience helps but isn't required. Interviews are at our office.

Seasonal warehouse associate at Northline Distribution, November to January. Picking, packing and shipping holiday orders. Must be 18. We have day and evening shifts at $19/hr plus overtime, and your first day is a paid orientation at the warehouse.

Ice cream scooper at Sweet Scoop Creamery. Serve customers, keep the shop clean and help open and close on summer weekends and evenings. $16/hr plus tips. A good first job if you're 15 or older. Stop by the shop for an application.

Caddies wanted at Pine Hills Country Club, mostly weekend mornings, carrying bags and helping golfers on the course. No experience needed since caddie training is free. With tips most caddies average $20-$30 an hour, and some qualify for the club's college scholarship.

Childcare assistant at the Community Center Kids Club. Help watch kids ages 3-8 while their parents work out, weekday evenings 5-8pm. Must be 16 or older and we provide CPR training. $16/hr. We interview and check references.

Ride operator, Funland Amusement Park. Run rides, check height requirements and keep guests safe. Seasonal: weekends in the spring, full time in summer. Minimum age 16. $16.50/hr and free park passes. Come to the hiring fair at the main gate any Saturday.

Tony's Pizzeria is hiring delivery drivers for orders within 5 miles of the store. 18+ with a valid license, insurance and a clean driving record. $14/hr plus tips and we pay mileage. Apply in the store.

Pebble Software is hiring a part-time remote customer support associate to answer emails and live chats about our scheduling app, 15-20 hrs a week. 18+ only. $18/hr through our payroll provider once onboarding is done. There are two video interviews with the support team lead, and we will never ask you to pay for equipment or training.
